CustomField.description: Bureau enquiry reference, copied onto the log rather than read through the Credit_Check__c lookup. The lookup is SetNull, so after a rollback or a retention deletion it resolves to nothing and the row would record that someone accessed an unnamed something. Holding the reference as data is what makes this audit record self-contained.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Bureau enquiry reference as it was at the moment of access
CustomField.label: Credit Check Reference
